item.title: Inside The Studio With Joyce Billet Featuring Large-scale Works & Studio Process
item.description: Miami, FL - December 3, 2025 - Guests stepped inside Joyce Billet’s studio for an immersive presentation that revealed the creative process behind her monumental works. Large-scale paintings, sketches, material studies, and digital models offered a rare look at the evolution of her practice, including her permanent mural for Dior’s New York flagship and her sculptural benches and canopies for a major public art initiative. item.title: Design Miami 2025
item.description: Miami, FL -December 3, 2025 - Design Miami opened to the public, marking the start of its 21st edition at Pride Park. The fair launched its “Make. Believe.” curatorial theme with more than 70 global exhibitors, including over two dozen first-time presentations. Galleries, special projects, and site-specific installations drew crowds throughout the day, setting the tone for a strong return during Miami Art Week. item.title: Art Basel Miami Beach 2025
item.description: Miami, FL - December 3, 2025 - Art Basel Miami Beach 2025 arrives with bold ambition, uniting the creative forces shaping the future of art across the Americas and the world. This year’s 23rd edition gathers 283 leading galleries from 43 countries at the Miami Beach Convention Center, spotlighting the cultural currents, histories, and innovations that define the American art landscape within a global dialogue. item.description: Miami, FL - December 3, 2025 - Factory Basel kicked off last night, igniting Miami Art Week with its biggest and most immersive edition yet. This year, Factory Basel returns to Factory Town thru December 7, transforming the venue into a five-stage, five-day marathon of world-class music that runs straight until sunrise. item.title: Ruinart Champagne at Art Basel Miami Beach
item.description: Miami, FL - December 3, 2025 - Ruinart Champagne marked Art Basel Miami Beach with an opening-day cocktail reception celebrating its 2025 Conversations with Nature program. The Ruinart lounge showcased the House’s collaboration with multidisciplinary artist Sam Falls, whose work reflected Ruinart’s ongoing commitment to biodiversity.
